digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III (Mtsedzi); Maundu & Tengnäs 2005 (Nzezi, Mtsezi)

teaser.en: Its sweet little fruits are a treat, but carvers prize it more for hard wood that becomes combs, spoons and fishing rods.
teaser.sw: Matunda yake madogo matamu ni kitamu, lakini wachongaji huuthamini zaidi kwa mbao zake ngumu zinazogeuzwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na fimbo za kuvulia samaki.

summary.en: *Mtsedzi* is a small evergreen tree of the coastal thicket and forest with shiny notched leaves and sweet fruits. Its hard wood is carved into combs, spoons and fishing rods and used in building.
summary.sw: *Mtsedzi* ni mti mdogo usiopukutika majani wa vichaka vizito na misitu ya pwani, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye kibonyeo ncani na matunda matamu. Mbao zake ngumu huchongwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na fimbo za kuvulia samaki, na hutumika katika ujenzi.

about.en: *Mtsedzi* is an evergreen shrub or small tree, usually 3 to 6 m tall. Its small, shiny leaves cluster at the tips of the branches, each one notched at the tip. Young shoots are covered with rusty hairs. Like other milkwoods it has a milky sap.
about.sw: *Mtsedzi* ni kichaka au mti mdogo usiopukutika majani, kwa kawaida wenye urefu wa m 3 hadi 6. Majani yake madogo yanayong'aa hujikusanya kwenye ncha za matawi, na kila jani lina kibonyeo kwenye ncha yake. Machipukizi machanga yamefunikwa na vinyweleo vya rangi ya kutu. Kama jamaa zake wengine wa jamii ya *milkwood*, una utomvu kama maziwa.

where.en: It grows in Cynometra thicket, coastal bushland, Brachystegia woodland and coastal forest.
where.sw: Hukua katika vichaka vizito vya Cynometra, nyika ya vichaka ya pwani, misitu ya miombo ya Brachystegia na misitu ya pwani.

uses.en: The sweet fruits are eaten. The hard wood is used in building and carved into combs, spoons and other carvings, and its straight stems make fishing rods. Leaves and roots are used in traditional medicine.
uses.sw: Matunda matamu huliwa. Mbao zake ngumu hutumika katika ujenzi na huchongwa kuwa vitana, vijiko na vinyago vingine, na mashina yake yaliyonyooka hutengeneza fimbo za kuvulia samaki. Majani na mizizi hutumika katika tiba za jadi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mtsedzi*; ICRAF's handbook gives *nzezi* and *mtsezi*. In Giriama it is *mtsezi* or *mtsedzi*, and in Swahili *mchambigi* or *mchedi*. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Manilkara sulcata*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mtsedzi*; kitabu cha mwongozo cha ICRAF kinatoa *nzezi* na *mtsezi*. Kwa Kigiriama ni *mtsezi* au *mtsedzi*, na kwa Kiswahili *mchambigi* au *mchedi*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea huuita *Manilkara sulcata*.

reason.sw: Cynometra, unaounda vichaka vizito ambamo mmea huu hukua

reason.en: Coast mimusops, a milkwood relative with edible fruit
reason.sw: *Mgama* (coast mimusops), jamaa wa jamii ya milkwood mwenye matunda yanayoliwa
